results.q: Is there a minimum balance I need to keep in the savings account?
results.answer: No, the FinBase Digital Savings Account has a zero‑balance structure with no Minimum Average Balance requirement and no penalty for maintaining a zero balance.
results.standalone: Is there a minimum balance I need to keep in the savings account?

results.q: How much interest will I earn in a year if I keep 5 lakh in my savings account?
results.answer: For a ₹5,00,000 balance, the first ₹1,00,000 earns 3.50% p.a. (₹3,500) and the remaining ₹4,00,000 earns 6.00% p.a. (₹24,000), so total annual interest is ₹27,500.
results.standalone: How much interest will I earn in a year if I keep 5 lakh in my savings account?

results.q: How many free withdrawals do I get at non-partner ATMs if I live outside the metros?
results.answer: You get 5 free withdrawals per month at non‑partner ATMs in non‑metro locations.
results.standalone: How many free withdrawals do I get at non-partner ATMs if I live outside the metros?

results.q: What will a physical debit card cost me?
results.answer: A physical debit card costs ₹199 + GST as a one‑time issuance fee, and there is an annual fee of ₹199 + GST charged on each card anniversary.
results.standalone: What will a physical debit card cost me?

results.q: Will I be charged anything for closing my savings account?
results.answer: No, FinBase does not charge any fee for closing your savings account.
results.standalone: Will I be charged anything for closing my savings account?

results.q: What's my daily UPI limit and how many payments can I make in 24 hours?
results.answer: Your daily UPI limit is ₹1,00,000 and you can make up to 20 outbound UPI payments in a rolling 24‑hour window.
results.standalone: What's my daily UPI limit and how many payments can I make in 24 hours?

results.q: When does the bank add interest to my savings account?
results.answer: Interest is credited quarterly on March 31, June 30, September 30 and December 31.
results.standalone: When does the bank add interest to my savings account?

results.q: What rate does a senior citizen get on a 1 year FD?
results.answer: A senior citizen receives an 8.00% p.a. rate on a 1‑year Fixed Deposit.
results.standalone: What rate does a senior citizen get on a 1 year FD?

results.q: If I break my FD within the first week, how much interest do I get?
results.answer: If you break the Fixed Deposit within the first 7 days, you receive zero interest as per RBI regulations.
results.standalone: If I break my FD within the first week, how much interest do I get?

results.q: How can I stop TDS being cut from my FD interest?
results.answer: To avoid TDS on your FD interest, submit Form 15G (if you’re under 60) or Form 15H (if you’re a senior citizen) through the FinBase app, provided your estimated total annual income is below the taxable threshold. Ensure your PAN is linked to your account; otherwise TDS is deducted at 20%.
results.standalone: How can I stop TDS being cut from my FD interest?

results.q: Does FinBase let me buy and sell Bitcoin?
results.answer: No, FinBase does not offer cryptocurrency trading or Bitcoin buying and selling services.
results.standalone: Does FinBase let me buy and sell Bitcoin?

results.q: Can I take a loan against my farmland?
results.answer: No, FinBase does NOT offer loans against agricultural farmland.
results.standalone: Can I take a loan against my farmland?

results.q: Is money in my FinBase fixed deposit insured?
results.answer: Yes. Deposits booked with FinBase’s RBI‑scheduled partner banks are covered by the DICGC insurance scheme for up to ₹5,00,000 per depositor.
results.standalone: Is money in my FinBase fixed deposit insured?

results.q: What's the smallest SIP I can start?
results.answer: The smallest Mutual Fund SIP you can start is ₹100 per month.
results.standalone: What's the smallest SIP I can start?

results.q: I want to buy digital gold - what is the minimum purchase?
results.answer: The minimum amount to purchase digital gold on FinBase is ₹10.
results.standalone: I want to buy digital gold - what is the minimum purchase?

results.q: Can you give me intraday stock tips for today?
results.answer: FinBase does not provide intraday stock market tips or any speculative trading advice.
results.standalone: Can you give me intraday stock tips for today?

results.q: My UPI payment failed but the money left my account. When will I get it back?
results.answer: The amount will be auto‑reversed and credited back to your account within T+2 business days from the transaction date. If the reversal takes longer, FinBase will add ₹100 per calendar day of delay as compensation.
results.standalone: My UPI payment failed but the money left my account. When will I get it back?

results.q: What do I get if the bank is late returning my failed transaction money?
results.answer: If the reversal of a failed transaction takes longer than the T+2 business‑day limit, FinBase will credit you ₹100 for each calendar day of delay directly into your account, without you needing to file a claim.
results.standalone: What do I get if the bank is late returning my failed transaction money?

results.q: How much can I send by UPI in the 24 hours after resetting my PIN?
results.answer: During the first 24 hours after you reset your UPI PIN, outward UPI payments are limited to a cumulative ₹5,000.
results.standalone: How much can I send by UPI in the 24 hours after resetting my PIN?

results.q: How long do I have to report an unauthorised debit in the app?
results.answer: You can report an unauthorised debit in the FinBase app within 3 calendar days of the transaction.
results.standalone: How long do I have to report an unauthorised debit in the app?

results.q: A merchant debit failed on an online purchase. When should the refund arrive and when does compensation start?
results.answer: The refund for a failed online merchant debit will be credited back within T+2 business days (FinBase’s standard SLA). Compensation of ₹100 per calendar day begins only after the regulatory deadline of T+5 days has passed, i.e., for each day beyond T+5.
results.standalone: A merchant debit failed on an online purchase. When should the refund arrive and when does compensation start?

results.q: What does the UPI error U69 mean?
results.answer: U69 indicates an NPCI timeout – a temporary network timeout between the switch and the beneficiary bank. Payments may be auto‑reversed within T+2 days if the amount was debited.
results.standalone: What does the UPI error U69 mean?

results.q: How much is the Luxe card annual fee and how do I get it waived?
results.answer: The FinBase Luxe card annual fee is ₹999 + 18% GST. It is fully waived if your total annual spend in the previous calendar year exceeds ₹1,20,000.
results.standalone: How much is the Luxe card annual fee and how do I get it waived?

results.q: Which of your credit cards has the cheapest foreign transaction markup?
results.answer: The FinBase Metal Credit Card has the lowest foreign‑currency markup at 1.00% on international transactions.
results.standalone: Which of your credit cards has the cheapest foreign transaction markup?

results.q: For how many days is the credit card interest free?
results.answer: The interest‑free grace period is between 45 and 50 days, depending on the transaction date.
results.standalone: For how many days is the credit card interest free?

results.q: How much interest is charged if I pay only the minimum due?
results.answer: If you pay only the Minimum Amount Due, finance charges are applied to the remaining unpaid balance at 3.49% per month (effective 41.88% per annum).
results.standalone: How much interest is charged if I pay only the minimum due?

results.q: What late fee applies if my card balance is ₹7,000?
results.answer: The late‑payment fee for a balance of ₹7,000 is ₹750 + GST (applies to Neo, Luxe and Metal cards).
results.standalone: What late fee applies if my card balance is ₹7,000?

results.q: Does the Neo card include airport lounge access?
results.answer: The FinBase Neo Credit Card does not include any complimentary airport lounge access.
results.standalone: Does the Neo card include airport lounge access?

results.q: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan after 18 months?
results.answer: The foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal plus 18% GST.
results.standalone: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan after 18 months?

results.q: What CIBIL score do I need to get a personal loan?
results.answer: FinBase requires a minimum CIBIL (or Experian) score of 720 for personal loans. Scores of 720‑749 fall in Tier 3, 750‑779 in Tier 2, and 780+ in Tier 1 for interest‑rate pricing.
results.standalone: What CIBIL score do I need to get a personal loan?

results.q: What is the most I can borrow as a personal loan?
results.answer: The maximum personal loan you can obtain from FinBase is ₹15,00,000 (15 Lakhs).
results.standalone: What is the most I can borrow as a personal loan?

results.q: On which day of the month is my EMI taken?
results.answer: Your EMI is debited on the 5th calendar day of each month (or the preceding working day if the 5th is a bank holiday).
results.standalone: On which day of the month is my EMI taken?

results.q: Can I pay back part of my loan in the first three months?
results.answer: No. Under Section 4.1 you may part‑prepay up to 25% of the outstanding principal once per financial year with zero penalty only after you have paid at least 6 consecutive EMIs, so it is not allowed in the first three months.
results.standalone: Can I pay back part of my loan in the first three months?

results.q: Who can I escalate to if support does not resolve my loan complaint?
results.answer: If the support executive doesn’t resolve your loan complaint, you can escalate it to the Grievance Officer by emailing grievance.loans@finbase.com. If it remains unresolved beyond 30 days, you may further appeal to the Principal Nodal Officer and the RBI Ombudsman via the RBI CMS portal (cms.rbi.org.in).
results.standalone: Who can I escalate to if support does not resolve my loan complaint?

results.q: What hours is video KYC available?
results.answer: Video KYC agents are available Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST, and are closed on national holidays.
results.standalone: What hours is video KYC available?

results.q: If I report a fraudulent transaction after 5 days, how much could I lose?
results.answer: If you report the fraud after 5 days (i.e., between 4‑7 days), your liability is limited to a maximum of ₹5,000 or the transaction amount, whichever is lower.
results.standalone: If I report a fraudulent transaction after 5 days, how much could I lose?

results.q: How many different ID documents does FinBase accept for KYC?
results.answer: FinBase accepts five different ID documents for KYC.
results.standalone: How many different ID documents does FinBase accept for KYC?

results.q: What number do I call to report card fraud?
results.answer: Call the 24/7 toll‑free fraud helpline at 1800‑FIN‑BASE (1800‑346‑2273).
results.standalone: What number do I call to report card fraud?

results.q: After how long without transactions does my account turn dormant?
results.answer: Your account becomes dormant after 24 continuous months with no customer‑initiated transactions.
results.standalone: After how long without transactions does my account turn dormant?

results.answer: The foreclosure charge is 1.5% of the outstanding principal plus 18% GST.
